column2: intro]
In stuffy museums, I feel so out of place,
With my creative madness, I’ll brush off their grace.
No need for a Picasso to learn how to appreciate,
True genius lies in simplicity’s state.
I love accessible art, no headaches or stress,
A splash of color, a tune to impress.
Talented artists, those who make us sway,
Crazy art’s all I need to brighten my day.
I’m a total hoot, a clown so unique,
My vibrant canvases have a carnival streak.
I scribble verses, with humor to share,
For those who want to escape without a care.
I love accessible art, light as a feather,
When it speaks to all and brings us together.
Funny rhymes, songs that make us cheer,
Crazy art’s what makes my passion clear.
[solo]
Let art sweep you away, with no fuss or confusion,
Laugh, dance, feel this vibrant infusion.
For accessible art is a true treasure,
That makes us laugh and feel pleasure.
[outro]
